editions.label: September 2026
editions.change_note: Inaugural ranked edition. New longitudinal baseline; prior v1 exposure and v2 pilot profiles are separate series.

editions.label: November 2026 · November 9
editions.change_note: November 9 review of all 50 companies. Deployed compute, enterprise controls and scarce power infrastructure strengthen selected scores; external cloud dependence tempers frontier-lab Energy forecasts. Same cohort and locked methodology. September is preserved; no October edition is backfilled. The 2026 assessment advances to November 9; 2027 and 2030 forecast target dates remain September 18.

editions.label: November 2026 · November 18 (event review)
editions.change_note: Event review under methodology 2.0.0. NVIDIA: the CEO's resignation and the board investigation cut forecast Compute to 95 for 2027 and 90 for 2030; current scores hold because control of the bottleneck has not yet changed. Anthropic's IPO pricing changes no score: capital is not control until it is committed to capacity. All other companies carry their November 9 judgments. The 2027 forecast ranks in this edition are frozen rank calls, graded after the September 2027 assessment is published. The first full quarterly review under 2.0.0 is in December.
